messages.subject: group vs interaction vs n-dimension vs nesting
parts:
Hello

I was wondering if there was any documentation that existed about the theory of the group=, control.group= terms for a particular variable. Conceptually, it seems to allow for two variables to interact, one within the other. For two iid random effects, this seems similar to iidnd. Similarly, it seems conceptually related to an interaction effect between two iid random effects. Finally, it seems conceptually similar to a mult-level nested effect generated using a model matrix and a "z" model-type.

Is there any documentation anywhere about "group=" and what it does? I've used it extensively, mostly following the Zuur et al book, but I could make a compelling argument that some of these could have been written as "iidnd", interactions, or nested effects.

Thanks!
Scott
